videos.label: Reckless Ben/Bricks and Minifigs New Lawsuit! Live Press Conference!
videos.description: Trial lawyer Martin E. Radner (Brother Counsel) reacts to the press conference about the federal lawsuit brought by four associates of Ben Schneider against American Fork City and 13 police officers. Includes the plaintiffs’ and their attorneys’ statements and legal commentary; Ben Schneider is not a plaintiff.
